svg.title: What USPS pages say about redelivery. Notice left, PS Form 3849: a delivery was attempted but not completed; the form lists carrier redelivery, Post Office pickup, or a Smart Locker if that box is checked. Schedule it, free, for a day rather than a time: with the QR code or online using the tracking or barcode number, by phone with the tracking number, or on the paper form for non-accountable mail only; for same-day redelivery, submit by 2 AM CST, Monday to Saturday. Change or cancel online with the confirmation number no later than the day before; only one request is allowed and a Return to Sender request cannot be changed. Who can accept: the addressee or an authorized agent, at the original address only; for signature mail, you or your agent must be there and signing the notice is not enough. How long it is held, in calendar days: Priority Mail Express 5 days after the first attempt; extra-service items 15 days; Collect on Delivery 30 days in one USPS table and 10 days in the text; the final notice shows the Return Date. Cannot schedule: an item already returned to the sender, an existing request, or an address that does not match the original.
svg.text: USPS redelivery
What the USPS pages say
Notice left: PS Form 3849
A delivery was attempted but not
completed. The form lists your options:
carrier redelivery, Post Office pickup,
or a Smart Locker if that box is checked.
Schedule it: free, pick a day
QR code, or online with the tracking or
barcode number; by phone with the
tracking number; or the paper form
(non-accountable mail only).
Same day: submit by 2 AM CST,
Monday to Saturday.
Change or cancel
Online with the confirmation number,
no later than the day before. One
request only; a Return to Sender
request cannot be changed.
Who can accept it
The addressee or an authorized agent,
at the original address only. Signature
mail: you or your agent must be there;
signing the notice is not enough.
How long it is held (calendar days)
Priority Mail Express: 5 days after the
first attempt. Extra-service items: 15
days. COD: 30 in one table, 10 in the
text. The final notice shows the Return
Date; after it the item goes back.
When you cannot schedule one
An item already returned to the sender;
a request already exists; or the address
does not match the original.
Sources: USPS Redelivery FAQs and the USPS.com
Schedule a Redelivery page; read Nov. 20, 2026
